chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except for that in which one suckles from a single breast for one year."

key_terms.الرَّضَاعِ: breastfeeding or suckling that may establish foster relations
key_terms.ثَدْيٍ: breast from which the infant nurses
key_terms.يَحْرُمُ: becomes prohibited in a legal sense

ai.seo_question: When does breastfeeding establish legal prohibition in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning fosterage through breastfeeding and when it establishes prohibition. It specifies a particular condition related to nursing from one breast for a year as the basis for the ruling mentioned in the text.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4673 - Al-Alaa ibn Razin narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except when a child nurses from one breast for a full year."
